description: This file defines the CassandraGatewayListProvider class implementing IGatewayListProvider for Orleans clustering with Cassandra. It manages gateway list retrieval, caching, and initialization specific to Cassandra-backed Orleans clustering.

classes.name: CassandraGatewayListProvider
classes.description: An internal sealed class that provides a list of gateway URIs for Orleans clusters backed by Cassandra, with caching and initialization logic.

methods.name: CassandraGatewayListProvider
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the provider with cluster, gateway, Cassandra options, and service provider.

methods.name: InitializeGatewayListProvider
methods.description: Asynchronously initializes the Cassandra session and queries, creates necessary tables.

methods.name: GetGateways
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the list of gateway URIs, using cache if valid.
